name: Developing AI-Powered Applications with LLMs on Google Cloud
description:
# [Developing AI-Powered Applications with LLMs on Google Cloud](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/developing-ai-powered-applications-with-llms-on-google-cloud?advid=1319&utm_source=eventbrite&utm_medium=event&utm_content=master_classes&utm_term=shubhra)

Learn how to harness the power of large language models (LLMs) using Google Cloud’s AI tools to build smarter, more responsive applications

This beginner-friendly webinar introduces you to the core concepts of LLMs and walks you through practical strategies for integrating them into real-world app development using Google Cloud’s robust AI ecosystem.

Join us to gain hands-on strategies, foundational knowledge, and practical resources that will empower you to start building AI-powered applications confidently, right within Google Cloud.

name: Career by Design: Moving from Reaction to Intention with Hannah Collier
description: Take a step back from the demands of everyday work and create a clear vision for your future. Join executive and career coach Hannah Collier for an interactive workshop that will help you assess your career, identify growth opportunities, and develop a personalized roadmap for success.

name: The Power of Conversational Leadership: Navigating Stakeholders, Strategy, and Truth in Program Management
description: Leadership isn't just about managing projects—it's about mastering the conversations that drive results. Join Dr. Qiana O’Leary to discover how truth-centered communication can help you influence stakeholders, navigate complexity, and lead with confidence and authenticity.

name: What Mission Control Taught Me About Communicating When the Stakes Are High with Dr. Joeletta Patrick
description: When the stakes are sky-high (literally), there's no room for vague updates or guesswork. Join Dr. Joeletta Patrick, a 28-year NASA veteran, for a session on the communication framework she used in Mission Control — and how it applies directly to project management.
